races.name: Ladbrokes 'Bet #5 Get #30 New Customer Offer' Novice Hurdle

runners_data.name: Switch From Diesel
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with highest RPR (140) but 24 days off could leave him needing the run despite his class advantage
runners_data.comment: Very smart bumper performer, highly tried over hurdles, drops in class with good prospects
runners_data.spotlight: Very useful bumper performer, 3-12 in that sphere, second to Bambino Fever at Leopardstown last year; Flat maiden winner over 1m4f (heavy); aimed high in five starts over hurdles, second in Listed race at this track in December, respectable eighth in Grade 1 company at Leopardstown; easy winner of maiden hurdle over C&D 24 days ago; has class, is ground-versatile and sets a good standard.

runners_data.name: Saporetti
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but 79 days since last start and weak recent form make him vulnerable despite going preference
runners_data.spotlight: Flat winner in France over 1m4f on heavy in November; reasonable hurdles debut when beaten 22l into fifth in maiden hurdle at Cork 79 days ago; likely out of depth here at this stage of his career.

runners_data.name: Playtime
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with tactical advantage but only 8 days since last run and proven vulnerable in handicaps
runners_data.comment: Proved disappointing when sights were lowered at Killarney 20 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Good winner of a Leopardstown maiden hurdle (2m, soft) in March; okay runs in handicaps last twicel beaten 9.25l into third at Tramore lto; vulnerable to a few here but won't mind soft ground.

runners_data.name: Magico
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from powerful Mullins stable, 28 days off but promising hurdles debut suggests improvement to come
runners_data.comment: Brings Flat rating of 89 following three British wins; of obvious interest on hurdles bow
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner in Britain (1m-1m3f); made promising start to hurdling career on stable debut after 11 months off when landing 2m1f maiden at Killarney 27 days ago, beating Tyson Fury by 4l; jumping was very novicey and needs to improve; form of that race has a solid look to it and he's a leading contender; wouldn't want much rain based on Flat form.

runners_data.name: The First Turn
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but pulled up last time and hasn't threatened since winning debut bumper
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner on debut, no impression in the Wexford maiden hurdle won by Iflallgoeswell
runners_data.spotlight: Thurles bumper winner on debut in October; hasn't threatened to go on from that since in three starts since, twice over hurdles; pulled up in hurdle race at Punchestown 38 days ago; needs plenty more and best watched.

races.paceDynamic: Playtime is the only natural front-runner and will control this race from the front without pressure, setting a manageable gallop on the Good to Yielding ground. With three hold-up horses (Switch From Diesel, Magico, The First Turn) and only Saporetti likely to race prominently, there's minimal early pace. The tactical setup creates a pedestrian tempo early before quickening late. This race shape strongly favours the front-runner Playtime, who can dictate terms and kick clear when ready.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Playtime Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Playtime gets an uncontested lead and sets moderate fractions
scenarios.body: Playtime can conserve energy early then quicken clear when ready, while the hold-up horses face a tactical disadvantage with no pace to aim at. The front-runner gets first run and builds an unassailable advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly dawdling and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Switch From Diesel's class advantage and superior RPR of 140 tells in a tactical battle, with Magico also benefiting from Willie Mullins' tactical acumen. The race becomes about raw ability rather than stamina.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Challenge Works
scenarios.trigger: If Saporetti races more aggressively and provides Playtime with company
scenarios.body: The increased early pace sets up perfectly for the closers, particularly Switch From Diesel who has the highest rating. Playtime gets softened up by having to work harder early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If nobody wants to make it a test and it becomes a crawling affair
scenarios.body: The race turns into a pure sprint where jockey positioning becomes crucial, potentially suiting the inexperienced riders who might get better splits. Fitness and tactical errors decide the outcome.

watchPoints.text: Playtime's jumping under pressure - any mistake when the pace lifts could be costly given his front-running style
Switch From Diesel's freshness after 24 days off - needs to be sharp enough to close the gap if Playtime gets away
Early positioning of Saporetti - whether he provides Playtime with company or sits back could determine the tempo
The First Turn's attitude after pulling up last time - any reluctance could see him quickly detached
Magico's jumping fluency on just his second hurdles start - needs to be slick to deliver his undoubted ability

races.name: Ladbrokes 'That's Ladisfaction' Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Hashtag Pretender
runners_data.note: Front runner returning from 258-day layoff with amateur jockey, likely to be keen early but stamina questions late
runners_data.spotlight: 1-9 over hurdles; promise in both chase starts; 8.5l second in Killarney beginners' (2m1f, gd-yld) and when 5l behind Birdie Or Bust in a novice at Listowel (17.5f, gd-yld) last September; worse off at weights with that rival and not seen since but can't discount on handicap chase debut in new headgear combination.

runners_data.name: Birdie Or Bust
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from top stable, disappointed at Fairyhouse last time but has strong course form when right
runners_data.spotlight: 2-11 over fences; rated 13lb higher over hurdles; ran well when second in Grade 3 novice here in October (War Correspondent third); has disappointed at Fairyhouse and when pulled up over C&D since returning from a break; needs to leave those efforts behind.

runners_data.name: War Correspondent
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who runs well in defeat, needs pace to aim at and may struggle if it becomes tactical
runners_data.comment: Better chaser than hurdler, pulled up in a similar race at Tramore on penultimate start
runners_data.spotlight: Not the easiest to win with but often runs well in defeat; beaten 7.75l off 3lb higher on his last start in this sphere at Wexford on penultimate; 9l fourth in claiming hurdle back there on latest; best chase effort came when a 6l third in a Grade 3 novice here (18.5f, gd-yld) in October (Birdie Or Bust second); big chance on that form and has won here over hurdles.

runners_data.name: Indiana Jones
runners_data.note: Prominent runner showing improved form lately, well-handicapped after good efforts at Aintree and here last time
runners_data.comment: Returned to form with a fine effort in the Topham, had decent 2m form early in his career
runners_data.spotlight: Back from a long spell in the doldrums with improved efforts in hot handicap chases at Aintree (2m5f, gd-sft) and over C&D (yielding) the last twice; big chance now dropped in grade with talented claimer taking off a handy 7lb.

runners_data.name: Listentillitellyea
runners_data.note: Prominent type but winless over fences, had valid excuse last time on unsuitable ground
runners_data.comment: Winning hurdler, 0-8 over fences but has run well in defeat, may go well if fit
runners_data.spotlight: Has won over hurdles but is 0-9 over fences; ground given as possible excuse for 45l defeat at Ballinrobe (2m1f, good) on return from 295-day break on latest; forecast rain a plus and has run respectably here before but others hold more pressing claims.

runners_data.name: Park That
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who is 0-5 over fences but ran well behind a subsequent big-race winner at Navan
runners_data.comment: Good second to subsequent Ayr scorer Moudan lto; up 1lb and steps up in trip; big player
runners_data.spotlight: Winning hurdler is 0-5 over fences but has run well in defeat at times; fine second behind subsequent Ayr premier handicap winner Moudan at Navan on penultimate (2m1f, sft-hvy); 20.5f may have stretched at Kilbeggan latest; drops back in trip now but would ideally prefer softer ground.

runners_data.name: Crescent Moon
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare who has never won over fences, showed improvement in mares' company at Killarney
runners_data.comment: Has run well at times over fences but pulled-up last two tries and not easy to fancy
runners_data.spotlight: Hurdles winner is 0-7 over fences and yet to trouble the judge; step in the right direction in a mares' chase at Killarney (2m5f, gd-yld) last time after successive pulled up efforts but more needed down in trip back in handicap company.

runners_data.name: Gaelic Arc
runners_data.note: Front runner badly out of form with recent falls, hard to trust despite leading tendencies
runners_data.comment: Enjoyed a productive summer last year, scored over C&D in June, in rear here on return
runners_data.spotlight: 2-30 over fences, both wins coming at Kilbeggan; is 5lb below his latest win but he's been out of sorts for a while and not an ideal preparation for this when falling at the fifth fence at Kilbeggan just six days ago; fourth in this last year but others make more appeal.

runners_data.name: Stuntman Steve
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse rated higher over hurdles, valid excuse when making mistakes at Tramore latest
runners_data.comment: 0-5 over fences, will appreciate the return to good ground, cheekpieces go on
runners_data.spotlight: 2-12 over hurdles and rated 8lb higher in that sphere; hasn't looked like exploiting lower chase mark in recent starts; valid excuse at Tramore latest (mistake at third, pulled up after stirrup broke); capable of better than that and can't discount, especially if the rain misses.

runners_data.name: Be Fierce
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who prefers testing ground, course winner over hurdles but limited chase form
runners_data.comment: Course winner over hurdles (yld) and fences (hvy), goes well fresh but ground a worry
runners_data.spotlight: Course winner over hurdles on testing ground; 1-6 over fences, the win coming on heavy ground at Tramore; not a bad effort back there on latest (15.5f, good) when a 14.5l fourth of 14 and eased 2lb; could go well if the forecast rain materialises.

races.paceDynamic: Hashtag Pretender and Gaelic Arc will dispute the early lead, though both have question marks - Hashtag Pretender returning from 258 days off and Gaelic Arc badly out of form with recent falls. This genuine pace should set up an honest gallop over the 2 miles, with prominent runners like Birdie Or Bust and Indiana Jones tracking close behind. The combination of two keen front runners and a relatively short trip means the pace will be solid throughout, creating a race where those that can position prominently early will have the edge over pure hold-up horses who may struggle to make up ground in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders maintain a strong pace throughout
scenarios.body: The solid gallop plays to horses like Indiana Jones and Birdie Or Bust who can sit handy and kick from the final fence. Hold-up horses will find the task too difficult from off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Hashtag Pretender or Gaelic Arc gets an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate fractions and kick clear approaching the last, making it hard for closers to reel them in. The 258-day break or poor form becomes irrelevant with tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses or becomes too pedestrian early
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks from the back of the field. War Correspondent and the other closers can time their runs to perfection.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders fall or pull up early in the race
scenarios.body: The field bunches up dramatically and it becomes a sprint finish where any running style can prevail. Fitness and jumping accuracy become the decisive factors over positioning.

watchPoints.text: Hashtag Pretender returning from 258-day break with amateur rider could easily blow up or make jumping errors under pressure
Gaelic Arc has fallen in recent starts and his front-running style could cause interference if he comes down again
War Correspondent needs a strong pace to be effective but could be left with too much to do if it becomes tactical
Indiana Jones has been running well lately and a market move would signal confidence from the Morris yard
Birdie Or Bust represents the in-form De Bromhead stable and any significant shortening would be notable

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Insure Your Acca On Football' Beginners Chase

runners_data.name: Da Capo Glory
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who needs strong pace to aim at, returning from 28-day break with solid chase form over course and distance
runners_data.comment: Three hurdle wins and fine run in the Martin Pipe; best chase effort came at Gowran in Feb
runners_data.spotlight: Talented hurdler rated 132 in that sphere; placed in three of four starts over fences, including over C&D (yld-sft) in December when 16.5l third behind Argento Boy; another decent effort when a 9l second behind Butch Cassidy in a Killarney novice four weeks ago; has won here over timber; big chance.

runners_data.name: Vicar Street
runners_data.note: Front-runner making chase debut for Mullins after 312-day layoff, but quality hurdles form suggests class edge over these
runners_data.spotlight: Turned over at short odds in Galway bumper on debut in August 2024; scored on hurdles debut on next start at Roscommon (20.5f, good) in July 2025; runner up in listed novice at Galway Festival later that month; off since; dam won over fences and market can guide on chase debut after a 312-day absence.

runners_data.name: Quantum Quest
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning sharper after Aintree run, with strong hurdles rating of 129 translating well to chasing
runners_data.spotlight: 2-9 over hurdles and rated 129; shaped well before tiring late on in grade 3 handicap hurdle at Aintree (24.5f, gd-sft) after break on latest; sharper now and makes chase debut with yard in hot form; dam related to chase winners; could go well.

runners_data.name: Kainsbourg
runners_data.note: Prominent type with French bumper wins and Grade 2 hurdles form, making chase debut after 214-day break for Elliott
runners_data.spotlight: 2-2 in French bumpers; 2-10 and rated 130 over hurdles; fine second in Grade 2 novice hurdle at Chepstow (19.5f, good) in October; tailed off in rated hurdle when last seen at Fairyhouse in November; that was too bad to be true and his dam won over fences so could improve for switch to chasing but stamina to prove for this trip.

runners_data.name: Wendrock
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with poor recent form since December 2024 maiden hurdle win, breeding suggests unsuited to chasing
runners_data.comment: No win since Dec' 2024, pulled up and beaten 23l last twice, cheekpieces tried
runners_data.spotlight: No joy since Leopardstown maiden hurdle win in December 2024; poor form in that sphere last season and not an obvious candidate for chasing on breeding; others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Game On
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with overreach injury concerns from last chase start, returning quickly on 16-day turnaround
runners_data.comment: Best form on good inc' m'den hurdle win; may need this first run back
runners_data.spotlight: 1-4 over hurdles and rated 113; pulled up on chase debut at Kilbeggan (20.5f, good) last June when 6-1 (suffered an overreach to left fore heel); beaten 20l on return at Limerick last month when 7-2; capable of better but a bit to prove for now.

runners_data.name: Fillyoureye
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making chase debut with solid maiden hurdle win here, but poor recent handicap hurdle efforts concern
runners_data.comment: Ran too freely when pulled-up as fav' at Fairyhouse last time; a shout if settling better
runners_data.spotlight: Chase debutant; rated 123 over timber; won maiden hurdle here in February (2m7f, sft-hvy); poor efforts in handicap hurdles the last twice; related to useful chase winners and not discounted for top yard.

runners_data.name: Mister Frostie
runners_data.note: Front-runner with modest form rated just 95 over fences, three poor chase efforts including two pull-ups
runners_data.comment: 103 rated maiden hurdler, PU and soundly beaten in m'den hunter chases last twice
runners_data.spotlight: Point-to-point winner; modest maiden over hurdles rated 103; rated 95 after three poor efforts over fences (pulled up, beaten 52l and pulled up); hard to fancy in this company.

races.paceDynamic: Vicar Street and Mister Frostie will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a solid gallop over this staying trip. The pace should be honest rather than frantic, as both leaders have stamina credentials and the distance encourages measured jumping. With prominent racers Quantum Quest, Kainsbourg, Fillyoureye and Game On sitting close up, the tempo will build gradually through the middle section. This genuine gallop over fences strongly favours horses who can travel prominently and have tactical pace to respond when the race develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Travellers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays honest but solid throughout with no collapse
scenarios.body: The prominent racers get first run and can quicken off a manageable gallop, with their tactical speed proving decisive over the staying trip. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on good jumping types who've conserved energy in behind the leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Vicar Street gets soft fractions and jumps fluently throughout
scenarios.body: The Mullins runner uses superior class to dominate from the front, with his hurdles rating of 129 translating well to fences on chase debut. Lesser opposition fails to peg back the quality leader who gets away with controlled fractions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is too strong and leaders tire badly
scenarios.body: Da Capo Glory's hold-up style pays dividends as prominent runners and leaders pay for aggressive fractions over the extended distance. The 9-year-old's experience and stamina reserves prove crucial in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders make jumping errors or go too slow early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any style can win, with jumping fluency and immediate acceleration mattering most. Form horses with tactical pace get caught out by unexpectedly messy tempo.

watchPoints.text: Vicar Street could be vulnerable on chase debut after 312-day layoff despite class advantage from hurdles rating
Game On's overreach injury from last chase start at Kilbeggan could resurface, especially on quick 16-day turnaround
Mister Frostie has been pulled up twice in three chase starts and could compromise the pace if departing early
Quantum Quest returns from 56-day break and needs to show sharpness improvement from tired Aintree effort
Da Capo Glory requires genuine gallop to unleash finishing kick but proven over course and distance in similar conditions

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Get More With Racing Bet Builder' Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Sammy Smart
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with two course wins but faces traffic danger in congested prominent pack
runners_data.comment: Did well last season, won over this trip at Puchestown and creditable efforts last twice
runners_data.spotlight: Both career wins came at this track, including off 5lb lower over fences in December over 2m4f; couple of good placed efforts this year, most notably when beaten 4l into third at Tramore in April (Aclass in second); let down by jumping when well-held over shorter trip at Ballinrobe 12 days ago; could figure back up in trip with 5lb claimer taking over.

runners_data.name: North Of Nashville
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with wide-margin wins, suits the pace setup perfectly with clean run likely
runners_data.spotlight: Two-time handicap chase winner by wide margins, both coming at Wexford, including last time when scoring by an easy 9l off 8lb lower mark; can go well again but didn't back up a similarly comprehensive win in 2023 so not guaranteed to reproduce that effort.

runners_data.name: Le Grand Vert
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who pulled up last time over fences, may struggle in crowded prominent pack
runners_data.comment: Rated 15lb lower over hurdles, 2lb wrong here though and best form on soft-heavy
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time chase winner, twice over this distance at Ayr on soft; pulled up on last chase run at Down Royal and below-par hurdles at Sligo 25 days ago; put two decent runs back-to-back prior to Down Royal effort and chance if bouncing back; enjoys soft ground.

runners_data.name: Aclass
runners_data.note: Another prominent runner who needs to avoid traffic problems, recent Tramore form gives confidence
runners_data.comment: Just missed out here last month and every chance off 3lb higher if in the same form
runners_data.spotlight: Winner of Tramore beginners chase (2m5f, soft); bounced back after a couple of underwhelming runs when beaten a neck off 2lb lower mark at Tramore two starts ago; probably did too much too soon at same track lto; one of the more likely contenders; stays this trip.

runners_data.name: Justabitofyours
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse but poor recent completion record makes him unreliable despite pace setup
runners_data.comment: Lost way since fine second in this race last year, hard to fancy on this year's form
runners_data.spotlight: Standout form in 14 starts came when beaten 1.75l by Je T'ai Porte at Limerick a year ago; not threatened to rediscover that run since and hasn't completed in last three starts; up in trip.

runners_data.name: Bodhisattva
runners_data.note: Stay-on hold-up performer ideally suited to this pace scenario despite long losing run
runners_data.spotlight: Strong stayer but winless in over three years and 1-24 over fences; positive run when fourth at Haydock two starts ago but didn't show much over the banks lto; mark continues to slide and shouldn't be discounted.

runners_data.name: Difficult Decision
runners_data.note: Lone leader will get uncontested lead but is 13 years old and may not stay strong
runners_data.comment: Dual hurdle and chase winner has regressed after a decent comeback run so questions
runners_data.spotlight: Dual hurdle and chase winner who has won off higher marks in the past; not shown enough this year in recent months in either sphere to suggest a revival is imminent.

runners_data.name: Noble Talent
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with poor recent form, 57 days off adds to concerns
runners_data.comment: Struggled this season inc' back over hurdles latest, below last winning mark the only plus
runners_data.spotlight: Has been struggling for over a year; three runs this year, pulling up twice and being well held over hurdles at Cork; slipping in the weights but little other reasons to recommend him back over fences up in trip in first-time blinkers.

runners_data.name: Tiffiny's Girl
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with recent hunter chase win, perfect for avoiding early traffic
runners_data.comment: Won a four-runner contest at Cork by 12l, seemed to enjoy better ground, looks progressive
runners_data.spotlight: Couple of fair efforts in maiden hurdles last year, not out of the first three in four point-to-points this year; landed a maiden hunters chase at Cork by 12l and backed up that run when second to Muskerry Rock at Wexford 30 days ago; on a fair mark on handicap chase debut and open to more improvement than most.

runners_data.name: Pourquoi Poi
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who won at this course but faces congestion issues
runners_data.spotlight: One win from seven starts coming at this track in a handicap hurdle (2m4f, good) in October off 87; backed that up when fifth at Thurles before fading tamely at Kilbeggan; okay debut over fences when beaten 10l into sixth at Downpatrick 15 days ago; bred to enjoy this step up in trip and an interesting handicap debutant.

runners_data.name: Secrecies Of Stone
runners_data.note: Prominent style puts him in danger zone with seven others wanting same position
runners_data.comment: Won over extended 2m5f last year; one completion from four starts since; tries new trip
runners_data.spotlight: Won over extended 2m5f at Leopardstown last year off 1lb lower, was set to back that up next time at Fairyhouse when unseating two out; not much to recommend in next three starts but fared a bit better over longer trip at Down Royal 33 days ago when fourth; dropped another 2lb and needs more.

runners_data.name: Reve Inoui
runners_data.note: Prominent runner improving over fences but needs to handle traffic problems
runners_data.comment: Much better last 2 chase outings and no surprise if he went close off a falling mark
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner who was struggling over hurdles when returning from a long absence but has fared much better in two starts in handicap chases, beaten 10l into fourth over 3m2f at Down Royal 55 days ago; drop in trip sure to suit and chance.

runners_data.name: Il Silenzio
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 305 days but won well last time over fences
runners_data.spotlight: Improved for being sent chasing last summer and landed a Roscommon handicap on his third start over fences when last seen 305 days ago, travelling powerfully before beating subsequent winner Hit The Frame by 2.75l; unexposed for an 8yo and big chance off 6lb higher mark if ready to go after absence.

runners_data.name: A Year Older
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer but tends to fade in finish despite recent 40-1 shock win
runners_data.comment: Easy win over hurdles and in contention when a faller over fences last time; progressive
runners_data.spotlight: Looked very limited until springing a 40-1 surprise at Fairyhouse over hurdles (3m2f, yielding) in January, form which has worked out well; fell four out over fences next time but made no mistake in scoring at Limerick 16 days ago, beating Cullenwaine by 0.75l; 5lb rise fine and he should relish this extra distance.

runners_data.name: Hascoeur Clermont
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse wearing cheekpieces for first time, recent fourth suggests improvement
runners_data.comment: On long losing run, no impact in two runs for this stable, cheekpieces now tried
runners_data.spotlight: Two-time chase winner, winless since November 2023; had been running poorly but ran better when beaten 10l into fourth at Limerick 16 days ago in first-time cheekpieces having been hampered two out; they're left on now and he's on a nice mark if he can build on that.

runners_data.name: Seventy Eight Team
runners_data.note: Prominent maiden off long break, 177 days absence is major concern
runners_data.comment: Maiden is rated just 83 over fences so has a mountain to climb in this company
runners_data.spotlight: A maiden in 18 starts, four over fences, but put in three fair efforts over fences last year, most notably when second to Hit The Frame at Wexford, before being pulled up at this track over hurdles 177 days ago; 5lb out of the handicap off basement mark here but could go well.

runners_data.name: Mistyburn
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won last time over hurdles at 3m trip, chasing debut a question mark
runners_data.spotlight: Improved for switch to handicap company last twice over hurdles, finishing third at Cork before scoring at Kilbeggan (3m, good) 43 days ago, beating Plain Or Battered by 1.25l; races off a 3lb higher chase mark here and a contender for last year's winning yard.

races.paceDynamic: Difficult Decision is the lone confirmed front runner in this 17-runner field, meaning he can dictate an uncontested lead over the extended 3m½f trip. Seven horses (Sammy Smart, Le Grand Vert, Aclass, Pourquoi Poi, Secrecies Of Stone, Reve Inoui, Seventy Eight Team) want prominent positions, creating dangerous traffic congestion 2-3 out as they battle for position behind the leader. With no pace pressure early, Difficult Decision can string them out, then the prominent pack will get in each other's way when the race develops. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the traffic and deliver late runs when the prominent runners have compromised each other.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack gets snarled up in traffic turning in while Difficult Decision sets modest fractions
scenarios.body: The congested prominently-raced horses will compromise each other's chances, allowing the patient hold-up performers to sweep past in the final furlong. North Of Nashville, Bodhisattva, Tiffiny's Girl and Il Silenzio can all capitalize on cleaner passages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Scores
scenarios.trigger: If Difficult Decision maintains his lead and the prominent horses fail to organize an effective challenge
scenarios.body: The 13-year-old veteran gets an easy lead, strings out the field, and holds on as the chasers get in each other's way behind. His proven stamina at this trip becomes the decisive factor.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Break Clear
scenarios.trigger: If 2-3 of the prominent horses manage to avoid traffic and mount a coordinated challenge
scenarios.body: Sammy Smart and Aclass, both proven at this track, break clear of the pack together and fight out the finish. Their superior ratings edge out the hold-up horses who leave their runs too late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Difficult Decision stops completely and the prominent horses also fail to deliver
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete lottery with unconsidered runners coming through late. Reve Inoui or Seventy Eight Team could sneak through at massive odds when the market leaders disappoint.

watchPoints.text: Sammy Smart and Aclass could get shuffled back in the prominent pack traffic jam turning for home
Difficult Decision may not handle the extended trip at 13 years old despite getting easy lead
North Of Nashville must overcome 21-day break but his hold-up style perfectly suits this pace setup
Il Silenzio returns after 305 days but his last chase win showed he travels powerfully from off the pace
Le Grand Vert pulled up last time over fences and may not handle the pressure in prominent pack

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Big Daily Boosts On Racing' Maiden Hurdle (Div I)

runners_data.name: Lucky Signal

runners_data.name: Jukebox Jolene

races.paceDynamic: Lucky Signal appears the only confirmed front-runner in this large field, likely to get an uncontested lead with minimal early pressure. Easter Bonnet, Cailin Deas, Firebrand, and Rosie's Wings should race prominently behind the leader, but none are aggressive pace-forcers. The bulk of this 23-runner field will settle in midfield and rear positions, creating a classic scenario where the pace-setters get first run but face a wall of closers in the straight. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed, as they'll avoid traffic problems and get better racing room than the hold-up horses stuck behind walls of inexperienced maidens.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Group Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Lucky Signal sets sustainable fractions and the prominent runners get clear racing room
scenarios.body: The pace-setters will have too much of a head start over the large pack of hold-up horses struggling for racing room. Easter Bonnet and Cailin Deas can capitalize on their forward positions to outkick the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Closer Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong or Lucky Signal fades from the front as expected
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses will find gaps late and overwhelm tired leaders with superior finishing kicks. The Weighbridge and Superficial can use their experience to navigate traffic and time their runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Lucky Signal stops quickly and the prominent runners also fade in the testing ground
scenarios.body: The race will become a scramble with no clear pace structure, suiting horses with tactical speed who can adapt. Rosie's Wings and Ludus Magnus can quicken when the tempo lifts late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders disappoint and racing room becomes crucial in the straight
scenarios.body: An unfancied horse with a good position will capitalize on the chaos among fancied runners. My Poetic Queen or other unconsidered runners could exploit the confusion.

watchPoints.text: Lucky Signal could stop quickly in final furlong as shown previously, potentially bringing down prominent runners Easter Bonnet and Cailin Deas
Traffic problems likely in straight with 23 runners funneling into limited racing room, particularly affecting hold-up horses like The Weighbridge and Superficial
Ground conditions firming from Good To Soft to Good To Yielding may not suit horses with soft ground preferences
Several runners including Matcho d'Agrostis and Bethpage Theatre have poor jumping records that could cause interference
Multiple trainers including Paul Nolan and Simon Cavanagh in poor form could signal their runners are not fully ready

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Big Daily Boosts On Racing' Maiden Hurdle (Div II)

races.paceDynamic: Lizzie Twigg is the sole confirmed front runner and will have an easy lead without pressure early, allowing her to dictate a steady gallop through the first circuit. The lack of other pace angles means the field will bunch up behind her, with prominent runners like Dorie Miller and Alaskan View tracking in second and third. This will create a sprint finish from the second last hurdle as the hold-up horses led by Livio, Coolishael and Little Ginger come with their runs. The sustainable pace followed by a sprint finish strongly favours horses with a finishing kick who can be produced late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Lizzie Twigg sets modest fractions and the race becomes a sprint from two out
scenarios.body: The patient tactics allow the classier hold-up horses to use their superior finishing speed when it matters most. Livio's Grade 3 French win and Coolishael's recent promise will prove decisive over this trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner steals it
scenarios.trigger: If Lizzie Twigg builds an unassailable lead and the pace collapses completely
scenarios.body: Her proven bumper form and the lack of early pace pressure allows her to get first run on the field and hold on grimly. The 63-day break could work in her favour with freshness.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent trackers strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely run and Lizzie Twigg comes back to the field turning in
scenarios.body: The horses tracking in behind can pounce when the leader weakens, avoiding the traffic problems that may affect the hold-up horses. Alaskan View's recent run gives him match fitness.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete outsider shock
scenarios.trigger: If the principals all disappoint and connections have been working quietly with a supposed no-hoper
scenarios.body: The weak nature of this maiden hurdle division allows an improver to strike at huge odds. Navy Waters' flat form or Sestini's Cork debut suggest hidden ability.

watchPoints.text: Lizzie Twigg could steal a march if given too easy a lead with no other pace in this large field
Several hold-up horses including Anam Geal and Rosie Brown are making their hurdling debuts after long breaks
The bottom-rated horses like Rattledelatch and Glengarriff are likely to finish tailed off in this competitive maiden
Navy Waters has useful flat form that could translate to hurdles if taking to jumping
Multiple horses including Cool As A Cat and Cometothinkofit have shown a tendency to fade badly in the finish

runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up and tailed off at Fairyhouse and Clonmel on first two starts; hood and tongue-tie reached for.

runners_data.name: Angelo Dundee
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent course record and consistent recent form for top yard
runners_data.comment: Decent form in bumpers; worth a market check on hurdles/stable debut after another break
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner at this track on debut three years ago; ran with credit in four winners' bumpers since despite a stop-start career; promising hurdles debut for new yard when beaten 6l at Down Royal (2m1f, good) 33 days ago, still signs of greenness after nearly a year off; could improve a lot and a leading contender with step up in trip sure to suit.

runners_data.name: Misery Hill
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fade pattern and poor recent form over various distances
runners_data.comment: Modest start in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle a month ago when sent off at 22-1, watch
runners_data.spotlight: Well-held on both starts thus far over 2m at Kilbeggan and extended 2m6f at Ballinrobe; unlikely to be winning a maiden based on that.

runners_data.name: Switched On
runners_data.note: Hurdles debutant with good pedigree but poor bumper form 200 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Decent pedigree, out of Irish Oaks second Roses For The Lady; beaten out of sight on debut in heavy ground bumper at Limerick 200 days ago; makes hurdles debut.

runners_data.name: Frankie's Freebie
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner with solid maiden hurdle placings but below-par recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Front-runner with solid form until poor Limerick effort last time; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner who ran some nice races when placed in maiden hurdles behind Zanoosh, Rebel Budz and Fillyoureye; below-par the last twice, however, including in handicap company at Fairyhouse 62 days ago; not finishing out his races and needs to bounce back.

runners_data.name: Petit Secret
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from top yard with bumper win and decent hurdles debut
runners_data.comment: Course bumper winner in 2023, harmed chance on comeback with an untidy round of jumping
runners_data.spotlight: Made winning debut in Fairyhouse bumper in December 2023, beating the smart Bleu De Vassy; returned from long absence on hurdles debut when beaten 9.5l by Playtime at Leopardstown in March; too keen and a bad mistake when tailed off at Fairyhouse 63 days ago; tongue-tie goes on now and one not to give up on for top yard.

runners_data.name: Forlio
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse transitioning from Flat with jumping concerns after recent debut
runners_data.comment: Dual Flat winner is rated 62 in that sphere; makes hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Dual Flat winner, rated 62; ran well when beaten 23l into tenth by Gomez Addams on hurdles bow at Listowel seven days ago; jumping needs to improve and he has a future in this discipline, but probably in handicaps.

runners_data.name: Ri Ra
runners_data.note: Consistent fader with poor recent form and big prices suggesting limited ability
runners_data.comment: Big prices and well held in bumpers; same strory on last month's hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Big prices and nothing of note in pair of bumpers and maiden hurdles; hard to recommend.

runners_data.name: Siofra Beag
runners_data.note: Poor Flat form transitioning to hurdles with fade tendency and 5lb claim
runners_data.comment: No sign of worthwhile form in five outings on the Flat, all on Dundalk AW.
runners_data.spotlight: Very poor form in five starts on the Flat; similar standard when sent hurdling when pulled up at this track 24 days ago.

races.paceDynamic: Brother Walfrid and Frankie's Freebie will contest the early lead, with both having confirmed front-running styles and the tactical speed to dictate terms. Angelo Dundee and Petit Secret are likely to track the pace prominently while the numerous hold-up horses will be positioned further back in this large 18-runner field. The two pace-setters should create a genuine gallop over this extended 2m3½f trip, stretching out the field and creating gaps. This race shape favors prominent runners who can track the pace and kick clear, as the hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground from the back of such a large field over the testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent runners prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Brother Walfrid and Frankie's Freebie set a strong pace early
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will stretch the field and allow horses tracking the leaders to strike decisively, while those held up at the back struggle to make up the ground in the testing conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runners dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is more measured than expected
scenarios.body: One of the early leaders will have enough left in the tank to see out the trip, with their tactical advantage proving decisive over the extended distance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle stages
scenarios.body: The race will become a sprint finish where the fresher hold-up horses can unleash late runs, catching the pace-setters who went too fast early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider breaks through
scenarios.trigger: If the main contenders fail to fire or make jumping errors
scenarios.body: An unfancied runner will benefit from a clear round and steady pace judgment to claim victory at long odds.

watchPoints.text: Brother Walfrid and Frankie's Freebie could set unsustainable fractions if they clash early over the extended trip
Angelo Dundee's jumping on just second hurdles start after impressive but careful debut
Petit Secret's fitness after 63-day break and whether the tongue-tie helps her settle better
The numerous lightly raced debutants over hurdles who could cause interference in such a large field
Whether the good to yielding going will slow the pace enough to help the hold-up horses

races.name: Castlestone Holiday Homes (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race

runners_data.name: Dee Bee Zed
runners_data.spotlight: Gleneagles gelding; closely related to 1m1f-1m4f Flat (inc AW)/Australian 2m hurdle winner Impulsar, half-brother to Listed-placed 7f/1m1f winner Silver Legend; dam unraced half-sister to 1m Group 2 winner; nicely bred but yard 0-7 in bumpers last five seasons.

runners_data.name: Ealu Tapa
runners_data.spotlight: Homebred Getaway gelding; dam placed 1m5f, sister to yard's high class jumper Peregrine Run and Takeyourcapoff (1m6f Flat and useful 2m-2m4f hurdle), out of bumper winner; likely type on paper worth a market check.

runners_data.name: Farney Bridge
runners_data.spotlight: Casamento gelding; dam unraced half-sister to winners Absolutely Doyen (useful 2m4f-3m1f hurdle) and Highway Jewel (3m1f chase), out of unraced half-sister to bumper winner; may need further than this in time.

runners_data.name: Go Loud
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to trouble the judge in four starts in point-to-points; likely best watched.

runners_data.name: Harbour Man
runners_data.spotlight: 150-1 and tailed off on debut at Fairyhouse in November; seems safe to rule out.

runners_data.name: It's Buster's Way
runners_data.spotlight: Doyen gelding; E21,000 foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Kalashnikov (high-class 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase), Kalane (useful 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase) and Holdbacktheriver (2m6f-3m2f hurdle/chase), from family of Kicking King; check the market.

runners_data.name: Lauro James
runners_data.spotlight: Lauro gelding pulled up in both point-to-points; can only be watched on Rules' debut.

runners_data.name: Sir Vinny
runners_data.spotlight: Walk In The Park gelding; dam unraced sister to 9.4f winner Aiseolas, half-sister to useful 7f 2yo/1m winner Home School; worth checking in the market for in-form yard.

runners_data.name: Union Boy
runners_data.comment: Newcomer for whom market best guide on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Workforce gelding; dam point/2m5f hurdle winner, out of half-sister to bumper winning dam of useful 2m/2m4f hurdle/chase winner Cruising Katie, is granddaughter of useful 2m hurdle winner; market check advised.

runners_data.name: Woodie Wiley
runners_data.spotlight: El Salvador gelding pulled up in point-to-points at Dromahane and Ballindenisk just over a year apart; can only watch on Rules' debut.

runners_data.name: Dieux Diligence
runners_data.spotlight: Saddex gelding; dam placed 1m4f Flat (RPR 74)/2m hurdle winner, half-sister to French winners Hillflower (2m-2m3f hurdles) and Yo Minfoutaie (2m1f hurdle); looks yard's main hope on rider arrangements.

runners_data.name: Iron Sword
runners_data.spotlight: For Fun gelding; dam ran three times in France, best effort at 1m4f (RPR 78), half-sister to winners Celtic Art (useful 1m-1m4f Flat inc 2yo; 2m/2m3f hurdle) and Warm Love (French 9.7f-1m3f); yard has success in this sphere; check market.

runners_data.name: Seamy Appletart
runners_data.spotlight: Blue Bresil gelding; dam placed 2m3f hurdle, sister to useful 2m4f/2m5f hurdle winner Atlantic Fairy; may need further than this in time.

runners_data.name: Which Flannerys
runners_data.spotlight: Order Of St George gelding; closely related to 2m1f hurdle winner Custom Of The Sea, half-brother to 1m5f/2m Flat/2m-2m4f hurdle winner An Bradan Feasa; dam unraced half-sister to high-class jumper Kalashnikov; looks yard's second string on jockey bookings but still worth a market check.

runners_data.name: She's A Divil
runners_data.spotlight: Vadamos filly; unraced dam closely related to bumper/2m hurdle winner Frontline, half-sister to 1m6f Flat and smart 2m-2m2f hurdle/chase winner Castlegrace Paddy, out of 2m Flat/2m hurdle winner; some appeal on paper and worth checking in the market.

runners_data.name: Returning Officer
runners_data.comment: Good debut when sixth in strong race at Navan; off 460 days; leading player if ready
runners_data.spotlight: Form of debut Navan sixth in February 2025 has worked out well; failed to build on that when a 7.75l fifth of 11 in a lesser race at Kilbeggan last month but may have needed that after a 460-day absence; better expected now.

runners_data.name: Working Class Hero
runners_data.comment: Distant second on C&D rules' debut; likely his optimum will be over further
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in a point-to-point; excellent efforts in defeat in both starts over C&D; stayed on to be a 12l runner up on Rules' debut (yielding) and beaten a head on good to yielding 24 days ago when ridden more positively; leading form claims.

runners_data.name: Noble Trix
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to bumper/2m3f hurdle winner Flying Trix and dam won a bumper too
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off when last of 12 in a Down Royal bumper on debut last month; unlikely.

runners_data.name: An Bhoireann
runners_data.comment: Beaten 82l and 25l in his two bumpers; now has tongue tied; couldn't recommend
runners_data.spotlight: No impact in two point-to-points; triple figure odds and beaten 82l and 25l in first two bumpers; tongue tie goes on now.

runners_data.name: Hurricane Leaf
runners_data.comment: Never involved when a 15l seventh of 10 on debut at Listowel last September, needs more.
runners_data.spotlight: Not disgraced on debut in a Listowel bumper when a 15l seventh of 10; didn't build on that at Sligo last time; much more needed.
